title: INGEST Source Certification
description: A signed human claim that a normalized artifact is faithful to its capture. Certification concerns faithfulness, never truth, publishability, or consent.

artifactDigest.description: Digest of the normalized artifact, computed at the moment of certification. Binding to a path instead is IN-09.

normalization.description: The transformations applied, so a reader can tell what was permitted to change. Condensing, reordering, improving, and summarizing are not normalization and their presence is IN-06.

human.description: Certification by a non-human party is IN-08.

supersedes.description: A correction produces a new artifact. Editing the raw artifact is IN-07.
